reviews.review:
Steven Day recommended this game.

We are no longer friends.

This game has a shiny new coat of paint compared to the first one.
Pros:
- More trinket slots.
- Massive build variations.
- Plenty of puzzles to solve.
- Perks are not limited by armor set like the 1st game.
- Dual Archtype builds leads to some pretty fun combos.

Cons:
- I ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hate Nerud map design I hope it gets exposed to 2 supernovas which collapses into blackholes and wipe it out of existence. I have wasted so much time trying explore the godforsaken wasteland just to get on with the main quest line.

- Weapons now operate on the feedback of try hard discord users such as the weird backstep moves to execute a special strikes. 

- This was a massive missed opportunity to implement parry and block combos along with shields for more melee build variations even though there are more weapon attack variations.

- The gear score system is redundant. I have seen no value in upgrading your weapons only for the enemies to become bullet sponges to balance out difficulty. Let along have varying difficulty runs. But I guess we need to spend those Simulacrums somewhere.

- You have a max of 60 trait points to spend on the numerous traits you find including the near useless ones. The first game allowed you spend enough to max out every trait you can find.

- Story is weak even in the first one but the choices made in the first one do not translate to the 2nd game. 

- I preordered the game. It was pointless. The rewards are obtainable in game.

- [spoiler] In the game at Ward 13 there is a mention of the The Iskal Queen who is now on Earth. Once again a big missed opportunity for a DLC there cause if you played the first game. You would know how bad this news would mean for the people on earth.[/spoiler]
Very fun, worth trying out. The levels and enemies are cool, I really like the weapons and the variety. Overall an improvement from the first game in everyway. No big bugs that I ran into.

An addictive experience designed for all who enjoy video games. With beautiful scenarios, high replay value, and versatile gameplay, the title offers excellent value for those who appreciate challenging action.
